title: The first target is the default goal
objective: Order the rules so that a bare make runs the greeting, while make goodbye still runs the farewell.
hint: With no goal on the command line, make runs the first target it sees in the file.

steps.description: make goodbye runs the second rule
the default goal does not run the farewell too

lesson.goal: 理解默认目标和显式目标的区别。
lesson.prediction: 裸 make 和 make goodbye 会分别选择哪条规则？
hints: 没有命令行目标时，make 选择读到的第一个目标。
移动整条规则时，目标名和它的 recipe 要一起移动。
让 hello 规则出现在 goodbye 之前。
lesson.explanation: 裸 make 只构建第一个目标；显式写出 goodbye 才会选择 goodbye。
